arStrings.szText: {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}{c_important}Grizzly Rage{/c} is now a {c_important}Werewolf{/c} Skill and Shapeshifts you into a Dire Werewolf. Dire Werewolves gain {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1*100|%x|]{/c} Critical Strike Damage, {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1*100|%x|]{/c} bonus Poisoning damage and Spirit Cost Reduction instead of Armor.
